title: Emission Schedule Under Unary Normalization
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The length-$t$ emission schedule of the input-normalized machine from $c$ equals the length-$t$ emission schedule of $M$ from the configuration obtained by viewing $c$ on the all-ones input of length $|x|$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite deterministic machine over the binary alphabet
A configuration of the machine on $x$
replaced: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine over the binary alphabet, $d$ a configuration and $t$ a step count. The emission mask of the input-normalized variant of $M$ over $t$ steps from $d$ equals the emission mask of $M$ over $t$ steps from the unary reinterpretation of $d$.
